evidence.note: Front-matter promise: countable-language versions of the completeness and omitting-types theorems.
Choice-free countable completeness with written proof; back-reference to sec:set-prerequisites-05.

components.rationale: The promised results exist and are labeled, but the success condition embeds the full acceptance clause, whose AC-scoping half fails: thm:fol-lk-completeness (inherited-04713-04920.tex:120-131) hypothesizes the Axiom of Choice for all signatures with no countable/choice-free version or scoping remark, although for countable signatures its proof only needs cor:fol-completeness-countable (and for finite sequents AC is avoidable altogether); the acceptance clause 'AC is hypothesized only where needed' is therefore not met for this completeness theorem. (Also noted, nearby: the compactness corollary at inherited-04921-04967.tex:34-38 assumes AC for the empty, countable signature.)
